title: Innokin Kwik 35K Prefilled Pod Kit
description: The Innokin Kwik 10+2 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit combines next-generation coil technology with a convenient dual-chamber e-liquid system for a smooth, consistent MTL (mouth-to-lung) experience. Compact and ready to use, each pod connects seamlessly to a built-in 10ml refill container that automatically feeds the coil, ensuring steady flavour and vapour with every draw. Powered by a 600mAh battery and USB-C quick charging, the Kwik 10+2 is built for everyday reliability. The leak-resistant construction, visible refill window, and inhale-activated design make this an ideal option for anyone seeking clear, consistent Nic Salt performance with minimal maintenance. The Innokin Kwik 10+2 delivers the precision and reliability that Innokin is known for, combining advanced pod technology with simple operation and extra-concentrated flavour for effortless all-day enjoyment. Please Note: This kit does NOT come with a USB-C cable Innokin Kwik 35K Kit Flavours • Blueberry Sour Raspberry A sweet-tart fusion of ripe Blueberry and tangy Raspberry for a balanced berry kick. • Cherry Ice Juicy Cherry paired with a crisp Menthol chill for a refreshing finish. • Cola Ice Classic fizzy Cola with a cooling icy edge for a smooth exhale. • Kiwi Passionfruit Guava A tropical trio of tangy Kiwi, sweet Passionfruit, and mellow Guava. • Lemon Lime A zesty blend of Lemon and Lime with a crisp citrus punch. • Menthol Cool, clean Menthol delivering a refreshing, icy vape. • Pink Lemonade Sweet mixed Berries blended with tangy Lemonade and a fizzy twist. • Sour Pineapple Tropical Pineapple flavour with a sharp, tangy sour note. • Strawberry Sweet, juicy Strawberry bursting with natural fruit flavour. • Strawberry Watermelon A smooth, refreshing blend of ripe Strawberry and fresh Watermelon. Innokin Kwik 35K Kit Flavours Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod firmly into the device until it clicks into place. Step 2 The internal refill container automatically keeps the pod topped up. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape—no buttons or settings required. Step 4 Recharge via USB-C when the battery indicator displays low power. Step 5 When both pod and refill container are empty, replace with a fresh pod pack. ✅ You're all set! Shop Innokin Kwik 35K Refill Pods
